mapper.select: select n.id, n.comment_id as commentId, n.actor_uuid as actorUuid, u.nickname as actorNickname, n.post_id as postId, n.post_snippet as postSnippet, n.content_snippet as contentSnippet, n.is_read as isRead, n.created_at as createdAt from comment_notification n left join user u on u.uuid = n.actor_uuid left join post p on p.id = n.post_id where n.receiver_uuid = #{currUserUuid} order by n.created_at desc
mapper.update: update comment_notification set is_read = 1, read_at = now(), updated_at = now() where receiver_uuid = #{currUserUuid} and is_read = 0
mapper.select: select count(1) from comment_notification where receiver_uuid = #{currUserUuid} and is_read = 0
